## Change

Describe the problem and what the change does. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and what you checked by hand.

- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass, with `ML_WORKSHOP_DATA_DIR` set to an empty temporary folder.
- [ ] Lessons: the starter runs and fails the checks, the solution passes, and plausible wrong answers are in `tests/test_wrong_answers.py`.
- [ ] New lessons: the worked example and prediction question are in `backend/lesson_guides.py` and `tests/test_guides.py`, and the lesson counts are updated.
- [ ] UI changes: checked at desktop and narrow widths, and in each lesson stage.
- [ ] No learner progress, notes, logs, credentials or machine-specific paths.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ShmalexM/ml-workshop/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
